The Democrats Who Voted Against Nominating Hakeem Jeffries for Speaker of the House

Representative Hakeem Jeffries of New York secured the vast majority of House Democrats’ support in his nomination for Speaker of the House . Eleven members of his party, however, voted against giving him the nod. The ballots were cast in secret, so the identities of some of the Democrats who cast “no” votes are not yet known.
